author: Vertyco
description: A small FarmVille-style farming game for ActivityHub, drawn with Zynga's original FarmVille art. Each player has one farm that follows them to every server and DM: till, plant and water 16 crops through week-long seasons, raise and breed 6 kinds of animals, unlock plots, upgrade tools and storage, dress the farmer, decorate the Yard and the extra farmhouse rooms, and climb a global leaderboard. The bot keeps the clock, so crops grow and animals get hungry while players are away. Works on desktop and on phones held either way. Server admins can turn on Neopets-style payouts from inside the game, so players turn FarmCoins into the server's credits at the Market's bank counter. Game design by Vainne (https://github.com/Atuelliss).
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs and display names with each player's farm, and counts each player's FarmCoin conversions per day.
install_msg:
Thank you for installing FarmCord!

FarmCord is a game for ActivityHub, which must be installed and set up first:
`[p]repo add vrt-cogs https://github.com/vertyco/vrt-cogs`
`[p]cog install vrt-cogs activityhub`
`[p]load activityhub`
Then follow ActivityHub's README: https://github.com/vertyco/vrt-cogs/blob/main/activityhub/README.md

Once both are loaded, FarmCord shows up in the hub's menu, and `[p]farmcord` posts a Play button.

Game design by Vainne (https://github.com/Atuelliss)
short: A FarmVille-style farm for ActivityHub: crops, animals and seasons, one farm per player
